verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents agents that claim human-approved tasks and open pull requests, plus its own advisory product-review GitHub checks with retest. Nothing in the evidence shows it detecting failed CI workflows, diagnosing them, or generating fix PRs from them. Tasks originate from user feedback or intentions, so the agent-PR flow is an adjacent feature rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have failed CI workflows automatically diagnosed and fixed with a proposed pull request
